_README: Cost unit is wall-clock seconds on the target box, derived from throughput_items_per_sec.
Model keys are UNVERIFIED placeholders. Workstream 5 replaces them from config.py once the
real NIM/vLLM model strings are confirmed — a wrong string that looks right costs hours.
scripts/calibrate.py rewrites the numbers and flips measurement_status to MEASURED.

UNVERIFIED-docparse-local._note: Serves the DOC_PARSE derivation, not a predicate class. Listing it under VISUAL would let binding pick it for a pictorial predicate on price and accuracy alone — but a document parser reads text, and no accuracy number on a labeled set of text extraction says anything about finding a photograph. The parse-vs-VLM choice belongs to type refinement, where the predicate's character is still visible.

UNVERIFIED-asr-local._note: Serves the ASR derivation, not a predicate class — same reason as the doc parser. A transcription model does not answer yes/no questions, and listing it under AUDIO let the naive binder pick it as the 'heaviest eligible' model for a predicate, costing 94s per segment to answer a question it cannot answer at all.
